questions.prompt: Which statement best describes a cell as a system?

answer_choices.A: A cell has parts that work together to help it survive.
answer_choices.B: A cell has parts that each work completely alone.
answer_choices.C: A cell only needs one structure to carry out all life processes.
answer_choices.D: A cell is not organized because its structures move randomly.

questions.explanation: A cell functions as a system because its structures work together to carry out life processes.

questions.prompt: Which cell structure controls many cell activities by providing instructions?

answer_choices.A: Nucleus
answer_choices.B: Cell wall
answer_choices.D: Cell membrane

questions.explanation: The nucleus contains genetic information that helps control many cell activities.

questions.prompt: Which structure helps control what enters and leaves the cell?

answer_choices.A: Cell membrane
answer_choices.B: Cell wall
answer_choices.D: Nucleus

questions.explanation: The cell membrane helps regulate the movement of materials into and out of the cell.

questions.prompt: Which cell structure releases usable energy from food for the cell?

answer_choices.A: Mitochondria
answer_choices.B: Cell wall
answer_choices.D: Cytoplasm

questions.explanation: Mitochondria release usable energy from food so the cell can carry out life processes.

questions.prompt: In many plant cells, which structure captures light energy to help make food?

answer_choices.A: Chloroplast
answer_choices.B: Cell membrane
answer_choices.D: Cell wall

questions.explanation: Chloroplasts capture light energy and help plant cells make food.

questions.prompt: Which structure provides extra support and protection in many plant cells?

answer_choices.A: Cell wall
answer_choices.B: Nucleus
answer_choices.D: Cytoplasm

questions.explanation: The cell wall gives many plant cells extra support and protection.

questions.prompt: Which part of the cell is a gel-like material where many cell structures are located?

answer_choices.A: Cytoplasm
answer_choices.B: Cell wall
answer_choices.D: Chloroplast

questions.explanation: Cytoplasm is the gel-like material inside the cell where many structures are found.

questions.prompt: In the model, blue arrows point through the cell membrane toward the cytoplasm. What interaction is the model most likely showing?

answer_choices.A: Materials entering the cell and moving through the cytoplasm
answer_choices.B: The nucleus turning into cytoplasm
answer_choices.D: Chloroplasts blocking all materials from entering

questions.explanation: The cell membrane controls what enters the cell, and materials can then move through the cytoplasm.

questions.prompt: A plant cell is not getting enough light. Which cell structures would most directly be affected in making and using food?

answer_choices.A: Chloroplasts and mitochondria
answer_choices.B: Cell wall and nucleus only
answer_choices.D: Cell membrane and cell wall only

questions.explanation: Chloroplasts help make food using light energy, and mitochondria release usable energy from food.

questions.prompt: A model shows arrows extending from the nucleus to several other cell structures to represent the nucleus directing their activities. What does this model best represent?

answer_choices.A: The nucleus provides instructions that help direct cell activities.
answer_choices.B: The nucleus is the only structure needed for survival.
answer_choices.C: The nucleus moves materials in and out of the cell.
answer_choices.D: The nucleus captures light energy.

questions.explanation: The nucleus contains genetic information that helps control many activities in the cell.

questions.prompt: If a cell membrane stopped working correctly, which problem would the cell most likely have?

answer_choices.A: The cell could have trouble controlling what enters and leaves.
answer_choices.B: The cell wall would disappear immediately.
answer_choices.C: The nucleus would stop containing genetic information.
answer_choices.D: The cytoplasm would turn into a chloroplast.

questions.explanation: The cell membrane regulates movement of materials into and out of the cell, so a damaged membrane can disrupt the whole cell system.

questions.prompt: A student says, “The cytoplasm is important because it holds structures in place and allows materials to move around the cell.” Which idea does this support?

answer_choices.A: Cell structures interact within the cell system.
answer_choices.B: The cytoplasm controls all genetic information.
answer_choices.D: The cytoplasm prevents all cell activity.

questions.explanation: Cytoplasm supports the cell system by surrounding structures and allowing materials to move within the cell.

questions.prompt: A model of a plant cell shows the cell wall outside the cell membrane. What does this arrangement help show?

answer_choices.A: The cell wall provides support while the membrane controls movement of materials.
answer_choices.B: The cell wall replaces the need for a membrane.
answer_choices.C: The membrane makes food while the cell wall stores genetic information.
answer_choices.D: The cell wall and membrane have exactly the same function.

questions.explanation: In plant cells, the cell wall provides support and protection, while the cell membrane regulates what enters and leaves.

questions.prompt: A cell needs energy to repair itself. Which structure is most responsible for releasing usable energy for this process?

answer_choices.A: Mitochondria
answer_choices.B: Cell wall
answer_choices.D: Chloroplast

questions.explanation: Mitochondria release usable energy from food so the cell can perform activities such as growth and repair.

questions.prompt: In the model, green arrows point from chloroplasts toward mitochondria, and energy symbols appear near the mitochondria. Which conclusion is best supported by the model?

answer_choices.A: Cell structures work together to support the cell’s energy needs.
answer_choices.B: Chloroplasts and mitochondria have no relationship.
answer_choices.D: Only mitochondria are needed for plant cells to survive.

questions.explanation: The model supports the idea that chloroplasts and mitochondria work together in the cell system by connecting food production and energy use.

questions.prompt: A student claims that the nucleus is important to the whole cell system, not just one part of the cell. Which evidence best supports this claim?

answer_choices.A: The nucleus contains information that helps direct many cell activities.
answer_choices.B: The nucleus forms a hard outer covering around the cell.
answer_choices.C: The nucleus controls what materials enter and leave the cell.
answer_choices.D: The nucleus captures light energy to make food.

questions.explanation: The nucleus affects the whole cell system because its genetic information helps direct many cell activities.

questions.prompt: A cell is compared to a school. The cell membrane is compared to the school doors, the nucleus to the office, and mitochondria to the power supply. What is the main purpose of this model?

answer_choices.A: To show that different parts have different functions that support the whole system
answer_choices.B: To show that all cell structures do the same job
answer_choices.C: To show that cells and schools are made of the same materials
answer_choices.D: To show that only one part of a system matters

questions.explanation: The model helps show that different structures have different functions, but they work together as part of one system.

questions.prompt: A plant cell has a damaged cell wall. Which explanation best describes why this affects the cell system?

answer_choices.A: The cell may lose support and protection, making it harder for other structures to function normally.
answer_choices.B: The cell will immediately stop having cytoplasm.
answer_choices.C: The mitochondria will become the cell wall.
answer_choices.D: The nucleus will no longer exist in any plant cell.

questions.explanation: The cell wall supports and protects the plant cell, so damage to it can affect how well the whole cell system functions.

questions.prompt: In the model, blue arrows point toward several mitochondria inside the cell. What does this model best explain?

answer_choices.A: Several structures interact to help the cell get and use materials.
answer_choices.B: Only the cell membrane is involved in cell survival.
answer_choices.C: Mitochondria prevent materials from entering the cell.
answer_choices.D: Cytoplasm stores genetic information.

questions.explanation: The model shows that the cell membrane, cytoplasm, and mitochondria interact as part of a functioning cell system.

questions.prompt: Why is it inaccurate to describe a cell as just a collection of separate parts?

answer_choices.A: Because cell structures interact and depend on one another to carry out life processes
answer_choices.B: Because cells do not contain structures
answer_choices.C: Because only the cell wall performs life processes
answer_choices.D: Because all cell structures have one identical function

questions.explanation: A cell is a system because its structures interact and depend on one another to keep the cell alive.

questions.prompt: In the model, the plant cell has several labeled structures, including the nucleus, chloroplast, mitochondrion, cytoplasm, cell membrane, and cell wall. Which explanation best describes how the model represents the cell as a system?

answer_choices.A: It shows several structures with different jobs working together to support cell survival.
answer_choices.B: It shows that plant cells only need chloroplasts to survive.
answer_choices.C: It shows that the cell wall controls all cell activities.
answer_choices.D: It shows that structures inside a cell are unrelated.

questions.explanation: The model represents the cell as a system by showing that many structures with different functions work together to support survival.
